mapper.select: SELECT owner_user_id, payee_user_id, alias, success_count, last_success_at, pinned, hidden, version, created_at, updated_at FROM contact WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND hidden = FALSE ORDER BY pinned DESC, last_success_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contact (owner_user_id, payee_user_id, alias, success_count, last_success_at, pinned, hidden, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{payeeUserId}, NULL, 1, #{lastSuccessAt}, FALSE, FALSE, 0, NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE success_count = success_count + 1, last_success_at = #{lastSuccessAt}, updated_at = NOW(3)
